caption: The drawing depicts a single large, ornate mug or tankard positioned centrally within a bordered rectangle. The mug has a bulbous, curved body with a slightly flared rim and stands on a circular, stepped base. On the left side of the mug, there is a decorative handle that features curves and a thumb rest at the top. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray using delicate pencil shading to suggest form and light. In the bottom left corner, there is a smaller, schematic line drawing of the mug in profile, including measurements and the initials "I-W" within a rectangular border. In the bottom right corner, there is a detailed front view of the handle, showing its full shape and attachment points. The name "MICHAEL FENG" appears at the lower right of the central drawing’s border. The background is an unshaded, plain tan or off-white color.
title: Silver Mug
